cross_engine_dependencies.relation: All tenant/project routes depend on E01 authentication, CSRF, RBAC/ACL, RLS, and project_access_guard.
Links raster/terrain products to project/layer catalog and explicit CRS metadata.
Raster PNG tiles (/raster/layers/{layer_id}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png) participate in E05 tile caching/ACL revocation.
Provides raster computation operations consumed by E08 processing_models DAGs.

edge_cases: Raster upload size limits, storage quota enforcement, and malformed GeoTIFF/COG rejection.
Explicit nodata propagation, band index bounds (1..16), formula sanitization in raster calculator, and resampling allowlist (near/bilinear).
Byte-range (HTTP Range / 206) serving on /raster/layers/{layer_id}/file must handle invalid/unsatisfiable ranges safely.
Terrain preview requires explicit elevation_unit='metre', valid vertical_reference, and acknowledge_dem=True (no survey certification claim).
